subject.title: feat: adopt shared OpenClaw design system palette

question: When should this stacked palette migration be allowed to leave draft given the private design-system dependency and global visual impact?
rationale: The code diff is narrow, but safe merge depends on package distribution, stack sequencing, and visual approval decisions that automation cannot choose for maintainers.

options.title: Keep Draft Until Access And Proof Work
options.body: Leave the PR draft until hosted CI/Vercel can install the dependency and the claimed route screenshots are attached or linked for review.

options.title: Accept Operator-Owned Credentialing
options.body: Proceed only if maintainers explicitly choose a cross-repository credential path and verify the combined stack before release.

options.title: Pause The Stack
options.body: If the design-system package will remain private without a consumer credential path, pause this PR rather than merging an undeployable dependency path.

recommendation.title: Keep Draft Until Access And Proof Work
recommendation.body: Leave the PR draft until hosted CI/Vercel can install the dependency and the claimed route screenshots are attached or linked for review.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick owns the current palette implementation history and authored the stacked design-system dependency path.
